name: sdlc-sessions
description: Session skills beside sdlc: /sdlc-recap says where a session stands and whether it can close, /sdlc-kickoff writes a Brief and starts a new Lead to carry it, and /sdlc-delegate makes the session a Lead that runs Workers in herdr terminals and gathers their Recaps, routing each Worker to a model and an effort by its ticket, and /sdlc-session names a herdr session as a Lead or a Worker and lists the live ones. It depends on sdlc, so every session keeps its guards.
